errors.text: The fracture morphology assignment is reversed: the target associates HPHT-induced ductility with distributed or isolated microcracking rather than long, connected interfacial cracks, whereas the generated hypothesis treats elongated cracks as the ductile HPHT signature and isolated microcracks as the brittle baseline signature.
The corresponding falsification rule therefore rejects the target-consistent fracture morphology and could produce the wrong mechanistic conclusion.
